subject: Procurement roadmap & technical surface alignment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Melton <sara.melton@eclipsehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement roadmap & technical surface alignment

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for taking time this morning — appreciated the clear articulation of the use case and the timelines. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Economic buyer and procurement timeline
- You indicated the committee will include a finance sponsor (Kevin Lau) and a clinical systems lead (Dan Reyes). Procurement review kicks off the week of Nov 8, with a two-week procurement window if no major redlines.

2) Security and technical scope
- You mentioned a SOC 2 review and a short security questionnaire from your InfoSec team. To accelerate, I’m attaching our standard security questionnaire (redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf) and a procurement timeline template that we can adapt.

3) Decision criteria (what you highlighted)
- Data residency and audit logging capability
- Predictable latency for patient-facing flows (95th percentile)
- Cost per 1k requests and reserved capacity options

Proposed next steps:
- Sara / Dan: confirm the final list of reviewers (economic buyer, legal, InfoSec) and share any internal SLAs for vendor evaluation by EOD Friday 10/22.
- Marissa / Priyom: I’ve looped you for follow-up on POC success metrics and the questionnaire. Priyom, if you can own intake with their InfoSec and confirm systems in scope that’d be great.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, procurement-timeline-template.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll book a 30-min sync for next week once Sara confirms availability.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive

From: Sara Melton <sara.melton@eclipsehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Dan Reyes <dan.reyes@eclipsehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement roadmap & technical surface alignment

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the attachments. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed reviewers: Kevin Lau (Finance, economic buyer), Dan Reyes (Clinical Systems), Priya Nair (Legal) and InfoSec (lead: Amanda Cho).
- Procurement window: we expect initial procurement intake the week of Nov 8. If InfoSec has no major concerns after the questionnaire, legal signs off quickly and procurement issues an SOW by end of Nov.
- Systems in scope: initially our patient-facing triage front-end and the anonymized event stream into the analytics store. We do NOT want third-party access to PHI — anything PHI-related must be redacted or tokenized before transit.

Action items for us:
- I’ll share the procurement checklist and our vendor evaluation rubric by Friday 10/22.
- Amanda (InfoSec) will reach out to Priyom directly to run through the questionnaire; expect an email from her early next week.

Thanks again — would prefer a 30-min call the week of Oct 26 to align tech/contract owners. I’ll propose times.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Melton | Head of Product Operations
Eclipse Health
sara.melton@eclipsehealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Melton <sara.melton@eclipsehealth.com>, Dan Reyes <dan.reyes@eclipsehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement roadmap & technical surface alignment — internal next steps

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Sara’s confirmation. Key points I want us to own before the week of Nov 8:

- Priyom: Amanda Cho (InfoSec) will contact you. Priority: confirm whether the patient triage front-end is in-scope as "non-PHI" for our model access pattern or whether they need tokenization. Also confirm what audit logs we can provide for requests and KV cache eviction traces.
- Marissa: POC metrics — let’s align on 95th percentile latency target (they indicated low-latency for patient flows), and cost / throughput scenarios. I’ll draft an LOE for a 2-week POC (reserved capacity + integration support).

I added a few suggested answers in the attached questionnaire for quick wins (see redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf). If we can return that to Amanda with answers + example logs by Nov 1, we should keep the Nov 8 procurement window intact.

Also, Sara asked for a procurement rubric — I’ve attached our procurement-timeline-template.xlsx and a stub HubSpot record link for the account.

Can you both confirm you can turn on this intake? If Priyom wants, I can join the initial call with Amanda.

Thanks,
Jonas

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Melton <sara.melton@eclipsehealth.com>, Dan Reyes <dan.reyes@eclipsehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement roadmap & technical surface alignment — security intake update

Thanks Jonas — I spoke with Amanda from Eclipse InfoSec earlier today. Quick intake notes and proposed scope: 

1) Questionnaire intake
- Amanda requested our completed questionnaire and an example request/response log (redacted). I’ve annotated the PDF with suggested answers for the following sections: data handling, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, and incident response.
- ETA: I can produce the redacted sample logs and the annotated questionnaire by Oct 28.

2) Systems in scope (confirmed)
- Patient triage front-end (only anonymized tokens allowed to leave UI; no raw PHI to inference layer).
- Analytics event stream (anonymized event bundle to analytics store).
- Internal admin tooling that will never receive PHI is out of scope for now.

3) Audit & logging capabilities
- We can provide per-request timestamps, token-level cost breakdown, model-version id, and KV-cache hit/miss traces. For PHI protection we recommend tokenization at edge and strict RBAC on any logs exported.

4) Next steps and owners
- Priyom (me): finalize questionnaire + redacted logs by Oct 28 and share with Amanda.
- Jonas: coordinate POC LOE and keep procurement timeline up to date in HubSpot.
- Marissa: draft the POC success criteria and latency targets (I suggest 95th <= 220ms for the triage flow in reserved mode; we can refine).

If Amanda wants a short tech deep-dive, I’m available on Oct 29–30. Otherwise we’ll push the questionnaire on Oct 28 and await InfoSec feedback.

Priyom Das | Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
